title: Lesson 14. Project: a greeting card
description: Make a card in Word yourself: title, picture, greeting, signature

questions.prompt: How do we make the card title?
questions.explain: The title is what people see first.

questions.prompt: What goes at the very end of the card?
The card should be saved in your Word folder.
Put in order how to print the card
Match the card part with what's in it
Where do we get the card picture?
options: Draw on the screen with a finger

learn.intro: Today you'll make a real card! Who is it for — mum, dad, grandma, a friend?

slides.text: Pick a reason: a birthday, "thank you", a holiday, "I love you".

check.prompt: Put the card plan from top to bottom
check.explain: That makes the card neat and clear.

slides.text: You do it, the teacher only hints: a new document, a big centred colourful title, a picture from Pictures, a greeting and the signature "From Aziz".

check.prompt: The student makes the card; the teacher only gives hints.
check.explain: It is your first fully independent work.

slides.text: Ideas: a border (the Design tab → "Page Borders"), page colour, emojis, different fonts.
Save it: "Card for mum" in the Word folder. Have a printer? File → Print → Print.

check.prompt: Where do you find a page border in Word?
